## What this step does

Validates `approval.yml`, `public_manifest.csv` and every approved file fingerprint before publication.

Only manifested files cross the publication boundary. Private review files remain in staging.

Updating the narrative public page is a separate Quarto task. See [Update an existing briefing](../../website/update-briefing.qmd).

## Inputs

| Input | Private location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Approved staging package | `$BNR_STAGING/briefings/{briefing_id}/` | Source of the approved analytical payload. |
| `review/approval.yml` | Package `review/` folder | Evidence of the completed authorised review. |
| `review/public_manifest.csv` | Package `review/` folder | Defines and fingerprints the exact approved payload. |

See [The BNR analytics and publishing environment](../../getting-started/environment.qmd) for the authoritative public and website-mirror locations.

## Run Briefing Step 3

1. **Open Briefing Step 3.** In Stata, choose User > BNR > Produce briefing > Step 3: Publish approved briefing.
2. **Select the briefing.** Choose the same briefing type used in Steps 1 and 2.
3. **Select the approved package.** Enter the release year, release month and briefing version.
4. **Confirm publication.** Tick Publish this exact approved briefing package.
5. **Publish.** Select Publish approved package.
6. **Check the run summary.** Confirm `Run status: PUBLISHED`, the correct package ID, approved file count and `Verification: PASSED`.
7. **Inspect the published package.**
   - Open `$BNR_PUBLIC/briefings/{briefing_id}/`; confirm the manifested datasets, figures, metadata, workbook and package files are present.
   - Open `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/briefings/{briefing_id}/`; confirm the website mirror matches the authoritative public package.
   - Open the release ZIP and spot-check its datasets, figures, metadata and workbook.
   - Confirm the website mirror contains no private `review/` files.
   - Open a sample dataset and figure from the website mirror to confirm they are usable.
   - Confirm the analytical package is published before changing the narrative Quarto briefing page.

## Outputs

| Output | Location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Authoritative briefing package | `$BNR_PUBLIC/briefings/{briefing_id}/` | Verified public analytical package. |
| Release ZIP | Authoritative package | ZIP containing only the approved manifested payload. |
| Website mirror | `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/briefings/{briefing_id}/` | Disposable package used by the Quarto site. |

## Command-line equivalent

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/briefings/bnr_step3_publish_briefing.do" ///
    "CVD incidence rates" 2024 1 1 publish
```

## If Briefing Step 3 does not complete

Read the Stata error and inspect both public destinations before rerunning.

Do not copy individual files manually to repair a partial publication. Resolve the cause and rerun the controlled Step 3 pathway.
